items.name: src/yggdrasil/ed25519.py — the in-repo Ed25519 implementation
items.notes: Deliberately hand-written rather than vendored: copying a third-party implementation into the tree is exactly what this register exists to prevent happening silently. Its honest limit — not constant-time — is stated in its docstring.
items.origin: Written in this repo for Y-011, following RFC 8032 (P-15)
items.use: Per-node keypairs and mesh-root node certificates with zero native dependencies, so identity runs on every node class

note: Licence & provenance (Y-018): every piece of this project that is not plainly the campaign's own new code, noticed in one place — the project's own licence and founding documents, every declared dependency, the runtime transitive closure, the standards referenced, and the one hand-written implementation. vendored is false for every entry: nothing third-party is copied into this tree. A new dependency lands only with its entry here, in the same slice (the Y-016 discipline, applied to provenance).
